verdict: Book the 2027-02-15 to 02-22 week at Eurostars Wall Street and build the trip around Lower Manhattan. It is the cheapest verified queen bed in the set, it is a three-minute walk from a Michelin star, and every starred cluster on the island is under 40 minutes away.

sections.title: What was decided, and why
body: The brief ranks hotels by how many Michelin restaurants are reachable within an hour by subway or bus. That measure turned out NOT to discriminate: all five shortlisted Manhattan hotels reached all five sampled Michelin clusters within 37 minutes. The '1 hour' rule eliminates nothing in Manhattan, so the ranking falls through to price, room quality and the single best walk-to-dinner distance.
On that tie-break, Eurostars Wall Street wins. It is $95 cheaper across seven nights than the next candidate and it puts a starred restaurant a three-minute walk from the lobby.

sections.title: The five hotels, cheapest first
body: Eurostars Wall Street, Queen, 172 sq ft, $848 for 7 nights ($121/night) before 14.75% tax and $4 per night city tax - non-refundable Partner Offer.
DoubleTree Chelsea, King, 210 sq ft, $943 ($135/night) before tax - free cancellation until 2027-02-13, the best balance of price and flexibility.
The Benjamin Royal Sonesta, Queen, $1,535 ($219/night) - the per-night figure does not reconcile with the stay total, so the row is marked unverified.
The Evelyn NoMad, Superior Queen, 180 sq ft, $1,652.52 - highest couples-location score at 9.5 and the fastest run to the Midtown 3-stars (13 minutes).
The Frederick Tribeca, Studio Queen, $1,747.42 - its cheapest room is a full bed, which fails the queen rule; the qualifying studio costs $140 more.

sections.title: The Michelin picture in one paragraph
body: New York currently holds 69 starred restaurants: five at three stars (Eleven Madison Park, Jungsik, Le Bernardin, Per Se, Sushi Sho), fourteen at two stars and fifty at one star, plus 76 Bib Gourmand and 224 listed-without-distinction restaurants. The official 2025 ceremony article names two more (5/15/52), and that conflict is documented rather than smoothed over.
Only seven of the 69 rows have fully captured hours, phone and booking partner at this stage; the rest carry name, tier, cuisine, area and a Michelin link, and are marked unverified for hours.

sections.title: What the trip actually looks like
body: The preferred window is 2027-02-15 to 02-18, which is a Monday to Thursday - and Monday is the weakest restaurant night in the city (Jean-Georges is closed both Sunday and Monday; Jungsik and Sushi Sho close Mondays too). The itinerary uses Monday for arrival, the free 9/11 Memorial and the three-minute walk to Crown Shy, then spends the remaining preferred-window days on MoMA, the Met and two three-star dinners.
Extending to the full seven nights adds AMNH, the High Line, the Statue of Liberty and a Sunday dinner at Per Se, the only three-star verified to trade all seven days.

sections.title: What is not known
body: Twelve open questions are catalogued on the Open Questions page. The four that could change the plan: the budget ceiling (it decides how many three-star dinners fit), the length of stay, whether a refundable room is worth about $177, and what happens to the star roster when the 2026 selection is announced around 14 December 2026.
Fourteen flagged items are on the Flagged for Review page. The most consequential is that every hotel total is quoted before tax, which understates the real bill by roughly 16%-18%.

sections.title: How to check this yourself
body: Every table row links to its source. The Repo Audit page lists the 18 sources used, the 15 findings with their status, and the method notes. The raw JSON behind every table is in the repository's data/ directory, so each claim can be re-derived rather than trusted.

recommendation.why: Cheapest verified queen bed ($848/7n pre-tax), 3-minute walk to Crown Shy, 17 minutes to Jungsik, and inside the user's preferred 15-18 February window.
recommendation.risk: The $848 rate is non-refundable and a Partner Offer. The refundable rate was $1,024.92 for the same room.
recommendation.fallback: DoubleTree Chelsea at $943 with free cancellation until 2027-02-13 if flexibility matters more than the $95 saving.
next_actions: Decide budget ceiling and length of stay (Open Questions Q-BUDGET, Q-NIGHTS).
Hold the hotel once the dates are firm; re-check the rate weekly.
Watch Resy/Tock for the five three-stars; tables open about 30-60 days out.
Re-check the Michelin roster after the December 2026 ceremony.
